mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for June 4, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Gaza's public servants systematically targeted in Israeli strikes. Months since Gaza's nominal ceasefire began, Palestinians continue to be killed and maimed in drone and airstrikes, including the enclave's police force which is crucial to peace and reconstruction efforts, the UN human rights office (OHCHR) said on Wednesday. This was reported by UN News. 2. Gaza aid volunteers enter fourth day of hunger strike in Libya. What began as a journey to deliver aid to Gaza has left ten international volunteers detained and on hunger strike in Libya. This was reported by The New Arab. 3. Israel's Knesset approves tax breaks for dozens of illegal West Bank settlements. International community considers settlements built in occupied Palestinian territory illegal under international law and major obstacle to 2-state solution. This was reported by Anadolu Agency. 4. Clashes test 'ceasefires' in Lebanon, Gaza, and the Gulf. Throughout the region, 'ceasefire'.
